mostWorthwhile.text: Making the drying rack was the most worthwhile step: fitting the net to planks gave the fruit-drying process a clear physical shape.

leastWorthwhile.text: Covering the jar was straightforward but less interesting than building and using the drying rack.

surprise.text: Thread and rope produced a net; I had expected something more like a drying line.

arbitrary.text: The purpose of combining thread and rope was unclear until it produced the net, though the offered options narrowed the choice.

continue.text: I would probably continue: assembling the rack and using it to preserve fruit made the sequence satisfying, though the compatible-options menu left little discovery.
